DT_Checkpoint9.text: CHECKPOINT 9 — Repurposed transit entrance with concrete barriers, municipal decals, layered security tech and scanners tuned differently for different bodies. Ordinary civic infrastructure turned into selective control.

DT_Overpass.text: ELEVATED OVERPASS — Aging structural infrastructure carrying heavy city traffic. Failure exposes both physical fragility and political dependence on posthuman labor.

DT_OversightOffice.text: OVERSIGHT OFFICE — Clean, fluorescent, tired municipal tower environment. Glass, controlled access, surveillance feeds, procedural authority and immaculate records; never glamorous.

DT_AugmentClinic.text: AUGMENT CLINIC — Converted parking-level medical and calibration workspace. Old concrete supporting advanced augmentation equipment; practical, busy, necessary.

DT_OrganicSafehouse.text: ORGANIC SAFEHOUSE — Humid lower-level residential/work space with improvised environmental control, worn furniture, repair benches and infrastructure access. Lived-in and protective, not a cyberpunk lair.

DT_DataCore.text: DATA CORE SUBLEVEL — Sterile white AI operations space with no public branding and deliberately neutral interfaces. AX10M is activated and assessed here.

DT_TransitSpine.text: UNDERCITY TRANSIT SPINE — Long maintenance corridors beneath the city carrying power, structural load and transit systems. Echoing, industrial and politically invisible until failure.

DT_WhiteFacility.text: WHITE FACILITY — Unmarked controlled site embedded inside ordinary city infrastructure. Sterile, unlived-in, designed for incident generation, vulnerability testing and deniable operations.

DT_SharedDistrictRooftop.text: SHARED-DISTRICT ROOFTOP — Exposed view across the Stack: sirens, drones, public projections, unrest and infrastructure. Recurring visual place for characters to see the city as a contested whole.
